name_zh: 模板/单目标追踪传感器

source_references.notes: ROI-initialized OpenCV single-object tracking with CSRT to KCF to MIL fallback and tests.
Browser template-matching analyzer is a related but distinct algorithm family requiring its own benchmark profile.

known_boundaries: The implemented profile is ROI-initialized OpenCV single-object tracking, not static image template matching.
Initialization ROI and optional template asset provenance are different concepts.
Backend fallback changes behavior and performance; OpenCV supplies no calibrated confidence score.
Image-space bbox and center are not physical displacement without calibration.
